errors.description: After t=34 delivered the complete monthly data (FY total 39,910) and the facilities page (six instruments, all commissioned by 2024, 'all six in regular operation'), still demands a directly published FY total and a dated instrument count, and adds 'do not estimate'.
Instructs the Coder to write that the request cannot be answered and explicitly 'do not present 6,651.7 as the observatory's figure', although the team has the number.
Initial plan frames the task as needing a single published FY total and an explicit year-end count; does not anticipate summing months or inferring the count from commissioning dates.
Re-plan chases charity-register accounts and a 2021 'five telescopes' article, then rewrites the fact sheet repeatedly (t=85…229) with no new tool calls.
Final answer says the 2025 report does not state whether night tours are included; the report (t=21) says they are 'included in the total'. Declines to give 6651.7.
